readers for 8th november msl: 418 6.00 pm helen freaney 8.30 am jim byrne 10.30 am mary cunniffe 12.30 pm margaret griffiths presentation sisters/cáirde nano nagle – wish to thank all who contributed in so many ways to the fundraiser, which was held in the old gardenfield school on sunday 18th october. the proceeds will go towards the building of a pre-school in rural zambia. ministers lavally 7th nov cortoon 8th nov reader: roisín walsh mattie nicholson eucharistic : ita ryan margaret fleming & nally families, st. enda’s avenue & mayo abbey. gerry o’brien, rusheens. edward & bridget ward, 4st. patrick’s please pray for teresa mannion, coolourty, abbeyknockmoy, sister of julie stapleton, vicar street. ann (dolly) cummins , (nee penston) ballindine & tubberjarlath road, tuam. monthly visits - fr. pat & fr. mark will attend to their monthly visits this week. fr. pat will do his calls on thursday 5th november at the usual time. all saints party! – on november 1st, an all saints kids party will take place in the parish centre from 1.30 p.m. - 3.30 p.m. dress up as your favourite saint whether its saint carlo acutis, saint jarlath, saint francis, saint patrick, saint therese, saint mother teresa, saint padre pio… lots of games and goodies with fun for all the family. all children must be accompanied by an adult. prizes for best dressed! festival of choirs , presented by tuam lions club, takes place in the cathedral on friday, november 20th, in support of tuam cancer care and the western alzheimer’s foundation. choirs include tuam cathedral choir, the tome chanters, baldonnel male voice choir, claregalway community choir, campbell’s community choir, cloughanover, dunmore church choir and cantar dunmore youth choir. tickets cost €25 plus booking fee and are available at eventmaster.ie. tickets are also available from quinns shop. mass cards - during the month of october €1,140 was received for mass cards signed at the parish office. these offerings, together with the intentions have been forwarded for the celebration of individual masses as requested. mass cards & christmas mass bouquets cards signed by fr. pat and fr. mark are available from the parish office . november mini vigil for the holy souls - takes place in the parish church at knock shrine on friday, november 6th from 9.00 pm to midnight. confessions are available from 8.00pm to 9.00pm in the chapel of reconciliation. rosary for the holy souls - t he rosary will be recited every sunday morning at 11:30am in the tuam cemetery, after 10:30am mass, for the month of november. we meet just inside the main gate. organised by the legion. everyone very welcome. cortoon & lavally intentions. saturday, 31st october - 8.00 p.m. lavally kevin geoghegan, cuilbeg, lavally. +++++++++++++++++ sunday, 1st november - 11.00 a.m. cortoon delia holiman, cortoon & deceased of the kelly family. john cullinane, brockagh. eddie gormley & deceased of the gormely family, ballaghalode. michael & catherine mullins & deceased of the mullins family, gallagh. +++++++++++++++++ saturday, 7th november - 8.00 p.m. lavally liam mannion, cappadavock, lavally (months mind) john joe & angela collins, cappadavock. lavally & deceased of the collins & sloyan families. +++++++++++++++++ sunday, 8th november - 11.00 a.m. cortoon jackie burke, carrarea.

mass satur day october 31st 6.0 0 p.m. jacqueline collins , bermingham road. the children’s rosary is a global organisation - dedicated to bringing children together in prayer. we are delighted to announce the launch of a new group in tuam commencing friday, 27th november at 6.30 pm. please note that all children must be accompanied by an adult for the duration of the rosary. all families are warmly welcome to attend. eucharistic ministers — all current eucharistic ministers in the parish are warmly invited to an enrichment and information evening in the parish centre on wednesday, november 4th, at 8.00 pm. the evening will be facilitated by niamh morris, and will follow up on several matters raised at the eucharistic ministers’ meeting on june 2nd. we look forward to welcoming all eucharistic ministers to what is hoped will be an informative and enriching evening. men of st joseph - the next meeting of tuam archdiocese men of st joseph group will be on the 1st of november at 7.00pm in the tuam parish centre, h54 t656. this month’s guest speaker is fr columba jordan cfr who will present a workshop on the topic of mental prayer. mosj is a group for men of all ages and backgrounds basing our gatherings on faith, formation and fraternity. new members are always welcome. come along and see for yourself! info
